[[File:Apprentice_Legislator.jpg|250px|thumb|[[Hologram/Legends|Holo]]-photo of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on her first day as an Apprentice Legislator.]]

An '''Apprentice Legislator''' was a position within the [[Apprentice Legislature/Legends|Apprentice Legislature]] organization.

[[Vidar Kim]] became [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] mentor after completing his stint as an Apprentice Legislator. Palpatine was an Apprentice Legislator for five years before being appointed as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Kim's [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had joined the organization at the age of eight, was eleven years old when she became an Apprentice Legislator.<ref name="DBPA">{{DB|character|amidala|Amidala, Padmé}}</ref>
